newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee stable on dlr, firmer vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee stable on dlr, firmer vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was stable against the dollar and firmer against the pound on Tuesday, reflecting international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 20.359 to the dollar, from same rate on Monday. The pound was fixed at a mean rate of 33.2545, from 33.354 on Monday.
"The mark's strong position in international markets is not only against the European currencies but also against the yen and the dollar," one dealer said.
Another forex dealer said the pound had undergone a correction in overnight international markets.
The dealer said the central Bank of Mauritius sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday, slightly below the prevailing interbank rate.
"The central bank's intervention has not really influenced the currencies' rates," another dealer said.
The dealer said the market was quiet, with banks in long forex positions after the central bank intervention.
